The presence of a methyl group (10-30 ppm) and methylene groups (25-50 ppm) is also consistent with the NMR data. The structure likely includes a phenyl group attached to a carbonyl, consistent with acetophenone derivatives. The molecular formula C16H16O suggests a phenylacetone derivative. I will now construct a possible SMILES string for this compound and verify it.

The structure is likely 1-phenyl-2-propanone with additional phenyl groups. The SMILES for 1,3-diphenyl-2-propanone is "CC(=O)CC1=CC=CC=C1C2=CC=CC=C2".
